items.stem: A permanent difference between accounting and taxable profit is one that:

options.text: Never reverses in a future period
options.rationale: Correct: permanent differences (e.g. disallowed entertaining) do not reverse.
Temporary, not permanent, differences create deferred tax.

options.text: Only affects cash flow, never profit
options.rationale: Permanent differences affect the tax charge in the period.

items.explanation: Correct: permanent differences (e.g. disallowed entertaining) do not reverse.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about deferred tax are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It arises from temporary differences between carrying and tax base amounts
options.rationale: Correct: deferred tax reflects temporary differences.

options.text: It is an accounting recognition, not an immediate cash payment
options.rationale: Correct: deferred tax is a book provision, distinct from cash tax paid.

options.text: It is the same as the current tax actually paid this year
options.rationale: Current tax, not deferred tax, is the amount payable now.

options.text: It only ever appears for companies making losses
options.rationale: Deferred tax arises for profitable companies too.

items.explanation: Correct: deferred tax reflects temporary differences.

items.stem: Because tax rules vary by country, generic tax guidance should be treated as:

options.text: A conceptual starting point that requires local professional advice to apply
options.rationale: Correct: jurisdiction-specific rules mean generic guidance is not a substitute for local advice.

options.text: A complete filing solution for any country
options.rationale: Generic guidance cannot replace jurisdiction-specific rules.
Tax law is jurisdiction-specific and not set by a course.
Concepts are useful, but local application is essential.

items.explanation: Correct: jurisdiction-specific rules mean generic guidance is not a substitute for local advice.
